description: Answers "Who filed for an IPO this week?", "Which IPOs priced today?" or "Any new SPACs?". Lists IPO registrations from EDGAR's live feed (about the last week), newest first, each with its stage: filed (first S-1, F-1 or S-11), amended (S-1/A, on the way to pricing), upsized (S-1MEF, registered just before pricing) or priced (424B4 final prospectus), the filing link, and whether it looks like a SPAC. Resale and follow-on registrations by companies that already trade are left out unless `include_public_companies` is true. Filter by stage or SPACs; poll with `since` (the previous `cursor`) to get only new filings. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

include_public_companies.description: Also list registrations by companies that already trade (resale and follow-on offerings). Default false: IPOs only.

limit.description: Most filings to return, newest first (default 25).

since.description: Only filings EDGAR accepted after this time: pass the previous answer's `cursor` to get just the new ones.

spacs.description: SPACs (blank-check "Acquisition Corp" shells): include (default), exclude or only.

stages.description: Only these stages: filed (first S-1/F-1/S-11), amended (…/A), upsized (…MEF, just before pricing), priced (424B4 final prospectus). Default: all.

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).

name: sec_ipo_filings
title: New IPO and SPAC filings
